messages:
elaine: Heads up — customer ACME reporting lots of 504s on /v1/rerank since ~10:40 UTC. p95 went from ~120ms to ~2.3s. Gateway logs show timeouts and a bunch of 502/504s. Any quick triage ideas?

michael: Hosted or Dedicated? region?

elaine: Hosted, us-west-2. Happened right after a deploy at ~10:42. Avg QPS ~180 for that org, batch_size ~8, candidates per query small (~2-4). Gateway: "timeout while awaiting response 504". Backend calls to ranker instances are timing out.

ingrid: Can you paste a repro request (headers + body) and any trace IDs? Also curious what retry behavior gateway is using — could be retry loop / thundering herd.

elaine: Sample curl and body:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"best restaurants near me","candidates":["a","b","c","d"],"top_k":3}'
```

trace ids: trace-abc123, trace-def456. No 413s or auth failures. Gateway logs show 3 retries configured for rerank route.

ingrid: Thanks. Quick checks: 1) Are there OOMs / container restarts on ranker workers? 2) KV cache hit rate? 3) Any traffic pattern change (spike vs sustained)?

elaine: Worker CPU and memory spiked at the same time; I see occasional OOM kills in worker logs and repeated 5xx from the worker process. KV cache hit rate dipped. Traffic was a sustained surge ~180 qps (higher than usual for this org).

sofia: Could be retry amplification — gateway retries -> more load -> more timeouts. Mitigation options: reduce retries for rerank to 0-1, enable circuit breaker to short-circuit when backend error rate high, or temporarily rate-limit this org.

michael: We have per-customer soft quotas but ACME is below the configured hard limit. Suggest temporary rate-limit to give workers breathing room.

ingrid: Quick mitigation plan I recommend: 1) Apply per-org rate-limit to 100 qps for ACME, 2) reduce gateway retries for /v1/rerank to 1 (or 0) for now, 3) enable fallback routing to a smaller quantized model variant for overloaded requests, 4) spin up extra worker pool as temporary capacity. Can do those changes now if ops agrees.

elaine: Applying rate-limit + retries change now. Pushing gateway config change.

oncall-bot: deploybot: gateway config updated by elaine at 11:06 UTC — changes: acme rate-limit=100qps, rerank.retries=1.

sofia: After the change p95 dropped from ~2.3s to ~160ms, 5xx rate decreased significantly. We're still seeing occasional 504s on requests with very large candidate lists (>50).

ingrid: Follow-ups for eng-runtime: 1) investigate worker OOM cause and memory leak possibilities, 2) add input validation to reject candidate arrays >50 with a 400, 3) update default gateway retry policy for rerank (no retries + circuit-breaker thresholds), 4) add autoscaling rule to trigger extra worker capacity earlier for sustained qps.

elaine: I'll file the support ticket to ACME with repro steps, traces, and what we changed. Also collecting host-level logs and container crash dumps. Ticket: SUP-4821.

ingrid: I'll own the postmortem and coordinate runtime fix. Please attach deploy hash, host IDs, and the worker docker image tag.

elaine: Will upload everything to the ticket and ping you. Thanks all :thumbsup: :tada:

michael: Great work. Recommend we also add a dashboard alert for rerank tail-latency > 500ms sustained for >5m so we can auto-notify oncall earlier.

sofia: Agree — adding alert and a playbook entry for rerank overload (reduce retries, rate-limit org, fallback route).
